name: na-staffing-crm
description: NA Staffing CRM — frontend (React/Vite) and backend (Node/Express/Prisma)

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.version:bump: npm version patch --prefix frontend --no-git-tag-version && node -e "const v=require('./frontend/package.json').version; console.log('✅ Version bumped to v'+v+' — restart dev server to see it in the app');"
scripts.sync:templates: git pull && npm run prisma:sync-templates --prefix backend
